$comment: Capability registry — ADR-0003. Renamed from v1.0's mcp.servers.json.
Secrets are secret:// URIs (ADR-0015). The ${GITHUB_PAT} interpolation from v1.0 was
broken — JSON does not expand variables and no component was named as the expander.
Container images are pinned by digest via artifacts.lock.toml (ADR-0013).
ADR-0011: there is no shell capability. Its absence is a decision, not an omission.

2026-08-03 — Every capability now declares requires_network, offline_allowed, owner, phase and trust_level. Required by capabilities-registry.schema.json v1.1.0 and enforced by L0-NETDEP-004. ADR-0007's L0 exclusion was previously expressed only in prose; it is now a machine-readable fact.

filesystem.governance_note: Reads files on the host. ADR-0012 classes file contents as untrusted, so output is external_content even though the capability itself is local.

github.note: ADR-0012 trust gate: content read from a file or web page can never trigger a push. Image pinned by OCI index digest (v1.1.2), obtained via docker buildx imagetools inspect on 2026-08-03. requires_network=true means ADR-0007 excludes this capability at tier L0 — see offline_allowed.
github.governance_note: Calls the GitHub API. ADR-0007 therefore excludes it at L0 — this is the declaration that was previously only prose (L0-NETDEP-004).

memory.note: ADR-0010. Direct qdrant-store / qdrant-find are NOT exposed.
memory.governance_note: In-process; Qdrant is local. Output is tool_result, BUT recall inherits each record's stored trust via MemoryQueryResult.trust_floor — a memory ingested from external_content stays external_content.

system.governance_note: Local telemetry (CPU, disk, battery). Not attacker-controlled, so tool_result rather than external_content.

media.governance_note: Local audio device enumeration and playback control. No external input.
